question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as a goal.
A great accomplishment is the subject of attainment.
The yoginis are the ones to whom one becomes dear.
inference: Through great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginis.
